name: crypto-primary-v1
description: Long-or-flat bitcoin trend ensemble sized by a 25% volatility target. Frozen before any forward data exists; changing anything here restarts the forward record and adds a trial (crypto/PLAN.md §8).

data.source: Bitstamp daily OHLC, pair btceur, UTC calendar days

signal.rule: mean over lookbacks of 1 if close/close[L days ago] > 1 else 0, giving 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 or 1

sizing.rule: target = signal * min(1, 0.25 / annualised stdev of the last 60 daily log returns)

band.rule: hold the current exposure unless the target moves by at least 0.10, or the target is 0 (then exit fully)

contributions: monthly deposits join the next rebalance; they buy BTC only up to the target exposure of the whole crypto book; the rest waits in EUR/EURC
execution: post-only limit orders, timed fallback to a market order
